title: NFL reinstates Broncos' Jonathon Cooper after placing LB on exempt list following pair of domestic incidents

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL reinstates Broncos' Jonathon Cooper after placing LB on exempt list following pair of domestic incidents
sources.description: Cooper, absent for Denver's 4-2 start to the season, will be eligible to return for the team's Week 7 road game versus the Arizona Cardinals.
